IGUI_OA_Econ_Reject_Own: Team supplies are not taken back.

IGUI_OA_Econ_Notice_Category: Codex: %2 filled. Bonus of %1 credits at the next settlement.

IGUI_OA_Econ_Notice_Kills: Kills: %2. Bonus of %1 credits at the next settlement.

IGUI_OA_Econ_Shop_Interval: The purchase interval has not passed.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Reason_taken: There is a machine here already.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Reason_notOutside: The water storage must stand where the rain falls (no roof).
IGUI_OA_Machine_Reason_nothingToShred: Nothing in your inventory can be shredded.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Reason_notMachine: Not a machine of the research team.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Reason_armed: It is armed. Only the spent shell can be removed.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_shredBench: Shred things by hand here: sample bundles come to your inventory.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_bulkShredder: Put boxes of goods in the input tab. Sample bundles come out in the output tab.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_cutter: Put clothes in the input tab. Rags, strips and leather come out in the output tab.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_propaneRefiner: Put rotten food and an empty propane tank in it.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_oilRefiner: Put oil, lard or seeds and an empty petrol can in it.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_woodSaw: Put logs in the input tab. Planks come out in the output tab. Loud.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_researchStorage: A big storage locker (300 once the limit is lifted).
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_rainStorage: Collects rain. Water pipes and tools treat it as a water source.
IGUI_OA_Machine_Hint_lure: Makes noise now and then for a day, then it is spent.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sight_Note: Lab record: the field of view has widened. The subject insists it was always this wide.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sight_Desc: Widens the vision cone (total angle). Added after darkness, tiredness and panic have narrowed it.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sixth_Note: The subject says the back of the neck prickles. We write it down.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sixth_Desc: A moodle-shaped widget lights up when a zombie is inside the radius.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sixth_Rank: The widget lights up when zombies are near. Radius %1 tiles
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_alarm_Note: Reads the alarm before it rings. The order, we are told, does not matter.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_alarm_Desc: Tells you whether a house or car has an alarm before you touch it. Marks alarmed houses and cars nearby as you pass.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_alarm_Rank: Know which houses and cars are alarmed before touching them
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ledger_Note: The ledger lists the containers you opened. The ones you did not, the ledger knows first.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ledger_Desc: Counts the containers in a building you have not opened yet. Containers you placed yourself are not counted.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ledger_Rank1: Tells how many containers in this building are still unopened
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ledger_Rank2: Also tells you when the building is fully searched
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ledger_Rank3: Also tells you when you walk into a building already fully searched
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_rich_Note: Search yields exceed expectations. Reports say the containers are offering things up.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_rich_Desc: Raises the chance of items turning up in containers and zombie corpses. Only affects containers filled from now on.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_night_Note: The dark steps back. It did not complain.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_night_Desc: Gives back some of the vision that darkness takes away.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_night_Rank: Restores %1 of the vision lost to darkness
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sense_Note: The subject counts footsteps through walls. The walls do not answer.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sense_Desc: Shows the presence of zombies on screen, but only while sneaking. Off when standing or running.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sense_Rank1: While sneaking, shows the direction of zombie presences
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sense_Rank2: Shows the distance as well as the direction
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_keen_Note: The eyes know what they seek before the eyes do. More sample bundles. Cause unknown.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_keen_Desc: Recovers more of what the research team looks for: meteor fragments at drop sites and sample bundles from dismantling.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ammo_Note: It is said that ammunition makes a different sound where it lies.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_ammo_Desc: Raises the chance of ammunition turning up in containers and zombie corpses.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sensePlus_Note: Presence now reaches those who stand still. It seems to be the presence that comes looking.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sensePlus_Desc: Presence Sense works in more stances and tells more things apart.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sensePlus_Rank2: Tells apart zombies that are breaking in; also shows cars, alarm sounds and the floors above and below
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_sensePlus_Rank3: Also works while running and sprinting
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_nightEye_Note: Researcher's note: the night now avoids the subject. No light was ever turned on.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_nightEye_Desc: Pushes Night Eyes to the end. The screen does not change; you see at night as by day.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_nightEye_Rank: Restores all of the vision lost to darkness
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_overload_Note: Past the limit, the body only half listens.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_overload_Desc: Counts less of the weight above your maximum. Every overload penalty reads that one number.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_overload_Rank1: Only %1 of the excess weight counts
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_overload_Rank2: Only %1 of the excess counts. Overloaded stumbles and fall damage are halved
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_moveSpeed_Note: The load has moved before the hand lets go.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_moveSpeed_Desc: Cuts the time to move items between containers and between the floor and you.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_keyring_Note: The keys gave up their weight. Whether they are made of metal is now in question.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_keyring_Desc: Keys on a key ring weigh nothing.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_keyring_Rank: Keys on a key ring weigh nothing
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_furniture_Note: A statement says the wardrobe helped carry itself. The wardrobe denies this.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_furniture_Desc: Raises the carrying efficiency of furniture you pick up. The weight is divided by (1 + total).
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_materials_Note: The logs have become slightly humbler.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_materials_Desc: Raises the carrying efficiency of materials such as logs, planks, nail boxes and paint.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_runSpeed_Note: The armor fails to notice the running.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_runSpeed_Desc: Lessens the running speed that worn gear takes away.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_capacity_Note: The limit, it turns out, was an agreement and not a number.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_capacity_Desc: Raises your carrying limit, on top of the Strength skill and traits.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_combatSpeed_Note: The arm does not remember the gear. The gear is hurt.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_combatSpeed_Desc: Lessens the attack speed that worn gear takes away.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_materialsPlus_Note: The materials have started to cheat on their weight. Only the scales are unaware.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_materialsPlus_Desc: Raises material carrying efficiency further. The number is the total with Material Weight.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_storage_Note: The box is deeper inside than outside. This disagrees with our survey records.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_storage_Desc: Raises the capacity of furniture and crates you store things in. Bags and the floor are not affected.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_armor_Note: Researcher's note: three layers of protective suit. The subject did not even say it was hot.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_armor_Desc: Worn gear is half as uncomfortable. Not gone entirely, so what to wear is still a choice.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_armor_Rank: Worn gear is half as uncomfortable
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_serumAdapt_Note: The serum recognizes the body. The body pretends to be meeting it for the first time.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_serumAdapt_Desc: Reduces the serum's side effects (nausea, fatigue).
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_serumAdapt_Rank2: No serum side effects. At injection a hallucination shows where a meteor fell
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_crowbar_Note: The door did not want to open. We had our reasons too.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_crowbar_Desc: Pries open locked doors, windows and cars with a crowbar. Fast and loud; each failure costs endurance and adds fatigue.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_crowbar_Rank1: Locked doors, windows, garages, car doors and trunks. Success %1
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_crowbar_Rank2: Reinforced doors too. Success %1, less noise, and supply crate seals come off faster
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_stiff_Note: The muscles break their appointment to stiffen.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_stiff_Desc: Slows how fast stiffness (muscle fatigue) builds up in your body parts.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_fall_Note: Height, the subject said, is only an opinion.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_fall_Desc: Reduces damage from falls from a height and handles the landing.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_fall_Rank2: No damage from a one-floor fall
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_fall_Rank3: Two-floor fall damage is halved, and you can run right after landing
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_lock_Note: The lock imitated the key first.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_lock_Desc: Picks locked doors, windows and cars with a paperclip and a screwdriver. Slow and quiet. A failure bends the clip.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_lock_Rank1: Locked doors, windows and car doors. Success %1
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_lock_Rank2: Reinforced doors too. Success %1, half the time
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_brush_Note: The brush clears a path. Records say the brush offered first.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_brush_Desc: Reduces how much forest and brush slow you. Multiplies with the Park Ranger and Lumberjack profession bonuses.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_brush_Rank2: Slowdown -%1. Fewer scratches in the brush
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_gear_Note: The clothes hesitate to wear out.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_gear_Desc: Lowers the chance that worn clothes and protective gear get damaged. Weapons are not affected.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resist_Note: Less room for illness to enter. The illness probably had its reasons.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resist_Desc: Slows how fast illness (colds, food poisoning and so on) builds up. Corpse smell and illness from corpses drop by the same share.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resist_Rank: Illness buildup -%1. Corpse smell is resisted by the same share
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_walk_Note: The same distance is crossed in different time. The clock has agreed.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_walk_Desc: Raises base movement speed for walking and running alike, also while sneaking or aiming.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resistPlus_Note: Once a week, the bite forgets what it was.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resistPlus_Desc: Lowers the chance that scratches and lacerations lead to infection, and lets you survive one bite without infection.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resistPlus_Rank1: Chance a scratch or laceration infects you -%1
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_resistPlus_Rank2: Scratches and lacerations -%1. Survive one bite without infection (once per 7 days by default, guaranteed)
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_dash_Note: Researcher's note: the one who runs makes the road. The one in the way lies down first.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_dash_Desc: Always on, no button. While sprinting, zombies in your way are thrown down. Each one costs endurance.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_dash_Rank: Zombies in your way are thrown down while sprinting. Too tired, and you just collide
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bHeavy_Note: Heavy things were only pretending from the start.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bHeavy_Desc: Raises the carrying efficiency of materials (paint included) and furniture. Without end.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bFamily_Note: Objects have families. We negotiate with each one separately.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bFamily_Desc: Pick one family of items with each point and raise its carrying efficiency.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bGear_Note: Wearing is an agreement between body and gear. It is renewed daily.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bGear_Desc: Lessens worn gear's discomfort. Adds to Armored Constitution's halving.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSpeedPen_Note: There is a way to soothe slow gear. It is not in the documents.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSpeedPen_Desc: Lessens the running and attack speed that gear takes away.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bOverload_Desc: Lessens the overload penalties (speed, endurance, climbing, defense).
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bTransfer_Note: The time of the move arrives before the load.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bLimit_Note: Beyond the limit there is a limit, and beyond that another.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bLimit_Desc: Raises your carry limit by 1 per rank. Without end.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bStorage_Note: The inside of the storage has not been surveyed.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bStorage_Desc: Raises the capacity of furniture and crates you store things in by 5 percent per rank.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bWound_Note: A wound no longer promises infection.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bWound_Desc: Lowers the chance that scratches and lacerations lead to zombie infection.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bIllness_Note: There is a place where the rate of illness is stored up.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bIllness_Desc: Slows illness buildup. Corpse smell and illness from corpses drop by the same share.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bBite_Note: The bite waits a long time in its waiting room.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bBite_Desc: Shortens the wait before the next bite can be survived.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bStiff_Note: A stiff body loosens once more. Once more, and once more.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bStiff_Desc: Slows stiffness buildup in body parts further.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bEndurance_Note: Breath was a loan. The interest has dropped.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bEndurance_Desc: Slows how fast endurance is used up.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSleep_Note: Sleepiness turns away at the door.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSleep_Desc: Slows how fast tiredness builds up.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bGearLoss_Note: Reports say clothes now outlive their wearers.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bGearLoss_Desc: Lowers the chance that worn gear gets damaged.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bFall_Note: The ground has agreed to catch you. Its reasons are unknown.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bDash_Note: The one who collides tires less.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bDash_Desc: Lowers the endurance Breakthrough Sprint spends per zombie.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bWalk_Note: The stride approaches an end value. The end value is not yet in sight.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bWalk_Desc: Raises movement speed. The more ranks, the closer it creeps to its end value (+40 percent), never reaching it.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bLoot_Note: What the containers give grows steadily closer to what we were looking for.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bLoot_Desc: Raises the chance of items in containers and zombie corpses, approaching an end value.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bShard_Note: We are already standing where the fragments land.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bShard_Desc: Increases the meteor fragments found at drop sites, approaching an end value.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bBundle_Note: The samples knew each other before they were bundled.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bBundle_Desc: More sample bundles from dismantling. 0.2 per rank (expected value).
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSense_Note: Presences are heard from farther away. Nothing is there, they say.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSense_Desc: Widens the Presence Sense radius by 1 tile per rank.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSixth_Note: The radius of the hunch has widened. The hunch had nothing to say.
IGUI_OA_Tree_Node_bSixth_Desc: Widens the Hunch radius by 1 tile per rank.
